issue.title: Select: typeahead never matches items whose label starts with an uppercase letter
issue.author: sebx
issue.body:
### Environment

acme/ui at 2b70204 (default branch). Any browser.

### What happens

With the menu open, typing `b` highlights nothing when the items are `Banana` and `Blueberry`.

### Minimal repro

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const value = ref()
</script>

<template>
  <USelect v-model="value" :items="['Apple', 'Banana', 'Blueberry']" />
</template>
```

Open the select and type `b`.

### Root cause

In `src/runtime/components/Select.vue`, `onTypeahead` lowercases the typed key but compares it with `item.label.startsWith(key)` on the raw label, so `Banana` never starts with `b`.
